scenes.cue: The Gingerbread Man. One day, the cook went into the kitchen
Then she took the square tins and cut out some square cakes
Then she went up to sweep the parlor
The old cook turned round as fast as she could
Now at the bottom of the walk, lying fast asleep in the sun
He thought at once that the cat must have stolen something
Meanwhile, the gingerbread man had climbed up on the garden wall
After a little while, the cat managed to pull herself out
Meanwhile, the gingerbread man had got to the bottom of the tree
But the monkey had jumped with one spring onto the lowest branch
And then what do you think happened? Why, little Bobby himself came running up
But Bobby was too hungry to mind gingerbread tears
